mainEntity.name: How do weight loss injections work?

acceptedAnswer.text: They mimic GLP-1, a natural hormone that regulates hunger and blood sugar, which helps you feel full sooner and eat less.

mainEntity.name: Who is eligible for weight loss injections?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eligibility depends on your BMI, health history and previous weight loss attempts. A doctor's assessment is required before treatment.
Some people have digestive side effects such as nausea, especially early on. Your doctor monitors you and adjusts the dose if needed.

mainEntity.name: Do I still need to diet and exercise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Injections work best alongside diet and lifestyle changes, which also help you keep the results after treatment.
